weights_source: ECG_JEPA repository, random-masking checkpoint from the README download link (MIT), epoch 99
pretraining_corpora: Chapman-Shaoxing with Ningbo (PhysioNet ecg-arrhythmia 1.0.0) and CODE-15; not PTB-XL, not Shandong, not Chongqing (ECG_JEPA README, Pretraining, read 2026-09-07; arXiv:2410.08559)
preprocessing: eight of the twelve leads (I, II, V1-V6) kept and the ten seconds resampled from 500 to 250 Hz by scipy.signal.resample, as the authors' ecg_data.py does. Not applied: nothing else -- their chain adds no filter and no normalisation
notes: published MaskTransformer, depth 12 read off the checkpoint, 768-d mean-pooled representation; input (B, 8, 2500); load_state_dict missing=0 unexpected=0
